schema.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.
schema.text: When you are held up on a car trip, how stressed do you feel?

ar.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: مثل الازدحام المروري أو اصطدام السيارات أو أعمال الطرق.
ar.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: عندما تتأخر في رحلة بالسيارة، ما مدى شعورك بالتوتر؟

de.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Zum Beispiel Stau, Zusammenstöße oder Baustellen.
de.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Wie gestresst fühlen Sie sich, wenn Sie auf einer Autofahrt aufgehalten werden?

en.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.
en.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: When you are held up on a car trip, how stressed do you feel?

fa.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: مثلاً ترافیک سنگین، برخورد خودروها یا کار در جاده.
fa.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: وقتی در سفر با خودرو معطل می‌شوید، چقدر احساس تنش می‌کنید؟

fr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Par exemple des embouteillages, des collisions ou des travaux.
fr.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Quand vous êtes retardé lors d'un trajet en voiture, quel stress ressentez-vous ?

hu.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Ha az autós úton feltartóztatják, mennyire érzi magát feszültnek?

it.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Quando resti bloccato o in ritardo in un viaggio in auto, quanto ti senti stressato?

tr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Örneğin trafik sıkışıklığı, çarpışmalar veya yol çalışmaları.
tr.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Araba yolculuğunda gecikmeye uğradığınızda ne kadar stres yaşıyorsunuz?
